name: Help Scout
summary: Shared-inbox help desk whose first-party hosted MCP server (mcp.helpscout.net/mcp, OAuth, read-only for new connections) lets an AI client list, search and retrieve conversations, threads, customers, mailboxes and reports. The vendor markets it as 'find and summarize', but states the connector 'makes no model calls of its own', so a connected AI model composes any summary while Help Scout supplies the read-only retrieval. One public MCP endpoint, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; each user connects with their own credentials and sees only what they may.

payments.notes: The pricing page is client-rendered (an ROI calculator dominates its text), so no plan figure is asserted here and humanBilling is unknown. The MCP needs 'any plan that includes Help Scout API access' and report tools need Plus or Pro. No separate MCP price; not machine-payable.
